title: The Ledger Resurfaces
payload: A dock boy brings the missing ledger to the hero, wrapped in sailcloth. One page is cut out. Show who sent him only through what he lets slip; do not name the sender.

title: A Watcher on the Quay
payload: Two turns after the ledger returns, the hero notices the same hooded figure for the second time. The figure leaves when seen. Do not reveal who it is.

all.judge: The hero and the dock broker are speaking privately and the broker lets slip doubt about the harbor council.

options.label: Hidden Action
options.text: Produce the torn seal receipt and confront the broker about the missing page.
options.hint: Only appears once the broker drops their guard.
options.payload: The broker goes still at the sight of the torn seal and quietly slides a brass locker key across the crate. Leave the choice of what to do with the locker to the player.

rewards.title: Brass Locker Key
rewards.description: Stamped with the harbor archive seal.

rewards.title: Archive Seal Mismatch
rewards.content: The torn receipt predates the official archive closure by three days, proving the ledger was altered from inside.
